newsitem.title: CHINA: China power ministry to issue 1.0752 bln yuan bond.
newsitem.headline: China power ministry to issue 1.0752 bln yuan bond.

text.p: China's Ministry of Power Industry plans to issue 1.0752 billion yuan worth of bonds, the China Securities said on Wednesday.

The interest rate on the bonds as well as their length will be announced following approval from the People's Bank of China, the central bank, the newspaper said. The Ministry of Power would guarantee the bonds, and had won a domestic AAA credit rating for the issue, it said.
The bonds would be issued nationwide in the near future, it said but gave no details.
The bonds would be used to finance the construction of 12 power plants throughout China, the newspaper said.
